11048.html:
11048 likháti 'scratches' AV., 'writes' Yājñ. [√likh]
    Pa. likhati 'scratches, carves, writes'; Aś.shah. likhapeśami, man. likhapita-, gir. likhāpisaṁ, dh. likhiyisāmi 'will write', NiDoc. lihati, Pk. lihaï, MB. lihe, Or. lihibā, M. lihiṇẽ, Ko. liuṁk, Si. liyanavā, caus. liyavanavā; Md. liyāka sb. 'writing'.
    *alikhant-.
    Addenda: likháti. 1. WPah.poet. līṇo 'to draw, write', Md. liyanī (absol. lī), liyum 'writing'.
    2. †likhyatē 'is written' Kathās.: OP. likhaṇu 'to write', P. likhṇā, B. lekhā, H. likhnā.
    †likhyatē see likháti.
    *liṅga-² 'defective' see *likka- Add².

10064.html:
10064 māraka at end of cmpds. 'killing' Kathās. (m. 'god of death' Śaṁk.) [√mr̥]
    Pa. -māraka- 'id.'; Pk. māraya- m. 'killer'; Sh. (Lor. lΛc̣o-māro 'butcher' (lΛc̣o gen. 'goat'); K. môrᵘ (usu. in cmpds.) m. 'killer', S. māro m.; N. -mārā in agent cmpds. 'being active in' e.g. bhāt-mārā 'a great eater'; Mth. mariyā 'hammer' (semant. cf. ghaná-¹); G. mārɔ m. 'killer'; Si. maru 'fatal, deadly'.

6573.html:
6573 daivasaka 'happening in one day' MBh. [divasá-]
    Pa. dēvasika- 'daily', °kaṁ adv. 'every day'; Pk. dēvasia- 'relative to day'; L. dehā̃, ḍehā̃, (Ju.) ḍ̠ehā̃ adv. 'by day, tomorrow', awāṇ. dḕā̃ 'tomorrow'.
    *daivika-, daíviya- see next.

3030.html:
3030 kāntā f. 'name of various plants, large cardamom' lex., °ta- m. 'Barringtonia acutangula'.
    Kt. ktə f. 'almond', Wg. ká̃̄ta, Kal. kānda; Kho. kándu 'wild almond tree' (< *kāntaka- BelvalkarVol 91).
